Можно изменить до начала игры. В общий п: You can change this until kick-off. The public average includes expectations from public profiles.
Откройте «Синхронизация», выберите нужны: Open Sync, select the leagues and dates, then choose Matches. Check the result for each league. Retry only the leagues that failed.
Обновите матчи за прошедший день. Заверш: Update matches for the previous day. Finished games become available for ratings. People who saved an expectation receive one notification.
Не запускайте очистку или полное наполне: Do not reset or reseed the catalogue for routine score updates. Those tools are for resetting test data.
Перечитывает показатели и последние матч: Refreshes database totals and recent matches. Does not import data from the provider.
Проверяет соединение с football-data.org: Checks the connection to football-data.org. Resolve any key or quota error before retrying the import. Configure the key in Vercel, not in this form.
Показывает результат действий в текущей: Shows results from the current admin session. Does not replace a database backup.
Выберите только нужные лиги. Начните с к: Select only the leagues you need. Start with a short date range to make results easier to check and reduce API usage.
Загружает календарь, статусы и счёт из f: Imports fixtures, statuses and scores from football-data.org. Running it again updates existing records using provider IDs. Check manual corrections after syncing again.
Обновляет текущий каталог игроков клубов: Updates clubs' current player catalogue. A current squad does not prove that a player appeared in an older match. General positions remain Defence, Midfield or Attack unless the provider supplies a specific role.
Сервер принимает даты YYYY-MM-DD. Если м: The server accepts YYYY-MM-DD dates. If a match near midnight is missing, check the neighbouring day and time zone.
Создаёт предварительный список сопоставл: Prepares proposed matches between records. Provider requests may use your API quota. Site emblems do not change until you apply the batch.
Сверьте клуб, страну и идентификатор пос: Verify the club, country and provider ID. Do not approve an uncertain match just because the names look similar.
Сохраняет одобренный пакет эмблем. Стату: Saves the approved emblem batch. Using an emblem to identify a club does not establish a licence or authorise player photos.
Откатывает изменения соответствующего па: Reverts changes from that emblem batch. Clearing the preview only discards the prepared result; it does not delete football data or ratings.
Укажите матч и доступный сезон. Сервер с: Enter the match and an available season. The server checks both clubs, the competition and kick-off time, then verifies starters and substitutes who played.
Это может быть ограничение тарифа или по: This may be a provider plan or coverage limitation. Do not substitute the current squad for a historical lineup or guess players from names.
Разрешает оценки только подтверждённых у: Enables ratings for verified participants only. Previous unverified ratings remain separate. Check the preview before applying it.
В разделе «Матчи» найдите нужную встречу: Find the fixture in Matches. Verify both teams, the date and the competition before saving.
Завершённый матч должен иметь подтверждё: A finished match must have a verified final score. Do not mark a match as Finished to test the live interface: it enables ratings, closes expectations and sends notifications.
Изменения применяются к выбранному матчу: Changes apply to the selected match. A later sync may update the record from the source again. Reverting its status does not reopen closed expectations.
Проверьте объект обращения и сохранённый: Check the reported content and the saved context. Personal blocking and reporting are separate actions.
Укажите конкретную причину решения от 10: Give a specific reason between 10 and 1,000 characters. The person who submitted the report will see it.
Закрытие жалобы фиксирует решение, но са: Closing a report records the decision but does not itself hide a post, delete a rating or block an account. Closing a report does not mean a sanction has been applied.
Удаляет футбольный каталог и связанные о: Deletes the football catalogue and related ratings. This is not a routine task. Save a backup first and verify that it can be restored. Read the exact list in the panel and enter the required confirmation phrase.
Применяйте только после осознанного сбро: Use only after an intentional reset of test data. Preview the catalogue first, then apply it. Check competitions, clubs, matches and emblems afterwards.
Миграция старых аватаров относится к обс: Migrating legacy avatars is a storage maintenance task. People change their photos in their own profile editor. Do not reset football data to fix a photo.

В разделе «Эксперты» введите никнейм сущ: Under Experts, enter an existing username. Agree with the author first. Their public ratings appear in the expert feed; profile and rating privacy remain in place.
Убирает экспертную отметку и оценки из э: Removes the expert label and their ratings from the expert selection. The account and ratings are preserved. Experts have no administrative privileges.
